continental-grid.basis: the HRRR CONUS v4 3 km Lambert grid (gpuwm.source_adapters._CONUS_3KM_LAMBERT, 1799 x 1059) outline, inset 110 cells (330 km) on every side, sampled every 40 cells; previously the lon/lat box [-125, 24, -66, 50] from configs/recipes/hrrr_v4_gsd41.toml:11
continental-grid.why: a lon/lat box laid out as a 3 km Lambert root by `gpuwm domain --recipe` inflates to its projected bounding box (the old box's root reached 17.3N and put 505,268 corners outside HRRR's grid, so --source hrrr, the row's own regional source, was refused); the outline inset 110 cells is the largest tested that fits (inset 100 left one corner row outside), measured 2026-10-17 on integrate/2.9.2: shape [1562, 926, 50] with --source hrrr
